gloss: making a vow to the gods for a wish

definitions.gloss: making a vow or prayer to the gods for a wish
definitions.explanation: Praying to a deity for a wish to come true, often with a personal vow or sacrifice kept until it does.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{願掛|がんか}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I made a wish at the shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{合格|ごうかく}する→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}つ→断つ：27885_tatsu⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{願掛|がんか}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I've vowed to give up sweets until I pass the exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{孫|まご}→孫：03731_mago⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{治|なお}る→治る：19598_naoru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{寺|てら}→お寺：23515_otera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{願掛|がんか}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}った→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother went to a nearby temple every morning to pray that her grandson would recover soon.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
A {願掛|がんか}け is often paired with a self-imposed sacrifice kept until the wish is granted: giving up alcohol, sweets or a favorite food, or not cutting one's hair. The word is used for such personal vows even without a visit to a shrine.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {願掛|がんか}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make a vow for a wish
- {願掛|がんか}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go (to a shrine or temple) to pray for a wish
- {願掛|がんか}け⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}つ→断つ：27885_tatsu⟧: to give up drinking as part of a vow

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{祈願|きがん}→祈願：13745_kigan⟧: prayer for something, more formal
- ⟦お{参|まい}り→お参り：16837_omairi⟧: a visit to a shrine or temple, with or without a wish
